executive_summary: Conessine exhibits highly favorable structural and spatial complementarity against the PelD Synthase ligand-binding domain, leading to efficient exopolysaccharide decay and subsequent biofilm matrix collapse.
next_validation_steps: Perform micro-dilution biofilm assays against P. aeruginosa strain to evaluate biofilm matrix collapse kinetics.
Evaluate competitive displacement of standard autoinducer ligands from the PelD Synthase pocket using fluorescent assays.
Verify non-specific cytotoxicity limits against mammalian cell lines.
